note: Other governments as model changes of the economy scene (the 'regimes' view): the same US hills on another state's foundation, drawn from the state's measured structure. Every measure carries its year, source and URL; null where no defensible source was found. Built by Tools/regimes/build.py from Tools/regimes/sources.json (research read by hand, with quotes) and the IMF, World Bank, OECD and V-Dem series fetched through their APIs. The industries' regulation and capture are Jev judgments (model evidence, not measurement).
